In detail

Avon and Somerset Constabulary recorded 50 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 5.2 per 1,000 residents, the 23rd highest rate of Bath's 33 wards. The daytime score here is driven by burglary (2), shoplifting (1), vehicle crime (0); the evening/night score by violent crime (9), anti social behaviour (2), robbery (0). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Publow & Whitchurch safe?

Wandroz currently rates Publow & Whitchurch in Bath as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bath during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bath at night. This rating is derived from Avon and Somerset Constabulary street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Publow & Whitchurch safe at night?

At night, Publow & Whitchurch is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bath. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.
